text:
maria_support: Customer reports structured JSON stream closing with partial object — client sees parse error. Adding repro and logs.

sarah_customer: Repro steps:
1) curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   -d '{"model":"open-redwood/qa-lite","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"give me a json object"}]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream

We observe SSE frames like this (order of arrival):

data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{\"id\":123,\"name\":\"Acme\",\"meta\":\"alpha\"}"}}]}

data:  

<connection closed by server>

Client-side JSON parser throws: "Unexpected end of JSON input" — the buffer contains: {"id":123,"name":"Acme","meta":"alpha"  (truncated)

We tried bypassing our internal proxy (direct to API) and still reproduce.

devin_engineering: Can you paste the request-id and response headers? Which SDK/client and region?

sarah_customer: Request-ID: rwd-req-01F8X3; region: us-west-2; client: node fetch (undici/fetch) with keepalive: true. Response headers snippet we captured:

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
X-Request-ID: rwd-req-01F8X3

kevin_infra: I pulled proxy logs around that timestamp. Excerpt:
```
[2026-02-12T14:22:11Z] rwd-proxy-01 upstream rwd-api-02 closed connection unexpectedly: EOF
[2026-02-12T14:22:11Z] rwd-proxy-01 client 10.2.3.4 keepalive closed
```
Looks like upstream worker closed during final flush. Also saw a short spike in memory on rwd-api-02 at the same time.

apm-bot: trace: rwd-trace-9c7; spans: request->runtime-serve(1.9s)->kvcache(0.3s)->streamer(0.1s) final span error: ECONNRESET

devin_engineering: Likely chain: runtime emits fragmented SSE data; a final empty SSE data event (or immediate socket FIN) races with socket close -> client sees truncated payload. Root causes to check: worker OOM, abrupt process restart, or explicit socket reset from load balancer. Immediate debug steps for customer: retry with simple resiliency on client: buffer SSE data until you see a final sentinel (we emit a `data: [DONE]` event when stream finishes) or until connection close, and only then parse.

Also for us: we should ensure server never emits an empty data event that looks like an in-flight separator. Two engineering actions: 1) make streamer atomic for structured JSON (emit full object as single data event), 2) add last-chunk sentinel `[DONE]` before closing connection in all code paths.

kevin_infra: Infra follow-ups: I'll check instance logs for OOM/restarts and LB healthcheck flaps. Could be keepalive mismatch between client TLS idle timeout and backend socket close. Also adding TCP keepalive/heartbeat from runtime might avoid early close.

maria_support: Action items:
- sarah_customer: enable client buffering to wait for `data: [DONE]` or connection-close before JSON.parse (short-term workaround).
- devin_engineering + kevin_infra: triage runtime worker mem & close semantics and add a server-side guard to avoid emitting empty SSE frames (ETA 24h).
- I'll follow up with status and a small test build for the customer to try.

sarah_customer: Thanks — implementing client-buffer now. Will update if it resolves.
